description: Source code for multiple master font support in FreeType, including functions for retrieving and setting font variation and design coordinates.

methods.name: ft_face_get_mm_service
methods.description: Retrieves the multi-masters service for a given font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_Multi_Master
methods.description: Gets multi-master font data for a face.

methods.name: FT_Get_MM_Var
methods.description: Gets variation data for a face.

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets design coordinates for a font face.

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Blend_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets blend coordinates for multi-master fonts.

methods.name: FT_Set_Var_Blend_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets blend coordinates for variation fonts.
